## Weekend caption
Little boats. Big singalongs. A whole woodland to wander. 🧡

Bristol, pick your family adventure for 19–20 September →

🎶 BELT OUT A SEA SHANTY
Sat + Sun, noon–6pm. Free, no booking. Great Eastern Hall, Brunel Square — the hall, not aboard SS Great Britain.

⛵ MAKE A PAPER BOAT
M Shed’s Docks Heritage Weekend has children’s boat-making on Saturday. Museum: 10am–5pm, free entry. Workshop times, cost and booking aren’t separately listed; check before a special trip. Boat trips and crane visits cost extra.

🥁 FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Trinity’s Sunday celebration: noon–4pm, music, nature and craft drop-ins. £0–£3 donation. All ages; under-14s with an adult. Parking charged; check individual workshops with Trinity.

🌿 FOLLOW LITTLE FEET
Tyntesfield’s final free-entry weekend. Estate 10am–6pm, last entry 5pm; no booking. Non-member parking £5. Slopes/gravel; pushchairs stay outside the house.

Pick one, pack a snack, let them set the pace. The hall and museum give you indoor options too.

Save your favourite 🧡 https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

Organiser details:
https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/bristol-sea-shanty-shout
https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/whats-on/m-shed/docks-heritage-weekend/
https://www.trinitybristol.org.uk/whats-on/2026/trinitys-community-day-celebration

## Estates replacement caption
Big days out. Small bill. 🧡

Two places for little legs to lead the way:

🌳 TYNTESFIELD — free entry through Sunday 20 September. Woodland wandering and a grand house to explore. Estate 10am–6pm; last entry 5pm. No booking. Non-member parking £5. Paths include slopes and gravel; pushchairs cannot go inside the house.

🌿 DYRHAM PARK — free entry AND parking Friday 18 and Saturday 19 September. Parkland, a play area and room for an adventure. 10am–5pm; last entry 4pm. House opens 11.30am. No booking. Steep and uneven ground; assistance dogs only.

Both welcome families. Choose a short wander for toddlers; let bigger explorers set the route. Food and extras cost more. Dyrham's free offer does not include Sunday 20 September.

Save the dates: https://donext.co.uk/bristol/
https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/bath-bristol/tyntesfield/events/181b773f-1fc7-4a87-8f4b-41c89c2dd4c8

## Art Cart replacement caption
Little hands. Big ideas. Zero entry bill. 🎨

Head upstairs at Arnolfini and let the making begin. The free Arnold Art Cart has creative materials, exhibition-inspired activities and table-top easels for families.

Tuesday–Sunday, 11am–6pm • second floor
16 Narrow Quay, Bristol BS1 4QA

It's self-led: settle in and make together. Materials vary. No numerical age limit is listed; younger children will need more grown-up help.

Keep this one for an indoor afternoon 🧡
https://arnolfini.org.uk/whatson/arnold-art-cart/

## Library replacement caption
Tiny people. Big singalong. 🎵

Nursery rhymes, songs and a little time together — without booking or spending a penny.

Bristol Central Library's rhyme and story time:
Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 10.45am
Around 20 minutes • ages 0–3 • older siblings welcome

Bring your grown-up: children stay with their adult. You'll find the library on College Green, BS1 5TL.

## Museum hunt replacement caption
A little detective mission for your next Bristol day out 🔎

Pick up a free map at Bristol Museum & Art Gallery, hunt for the tiny Aardman treasures and tick them off together.

Free museum entry + free hunt
Tuesday–Sunday, 10am–5pm
Running until 1 November 2026
Queens Road, Bristol BS8 1RL

For families and curious explorers of all ages. The British and World Wildlife Galleries are closed, so plan around the open galleries.

Who's your best clue-spotter? 🧡

## Design standard going forward
Orange, cream, navy and teal; tactile illustration, recognisable activity, bold child-centred headline. One idea per slide, legible logistics, exact approved city logo. Keep production notes and asset names out of public captions. Do not repeat plain text-box cards. Use AI disclosure for generated illustration; never present it as venue photography.
